li.label: amphetamines withdrawal
li.description: My brain feels completely hollow, and I don't even have the strength to lift a finger. Everything in the world looks so dark and miserable. Please... I need that drug. Just one more dose and I'll be perfectly fine...

li.label: cocaine withdrawal
li.description: Everything feels flat and empty. My nerves are crawling under my skin, and I cannot stop thinking about that sharp rush. One more drink. I just need one more.

li.label: Z-drugs withdrawal
li.description: I'm bone-tired, but my brain absolutely refuses to shut down. Whenever I close my eyes, bizarre shapes seem to mock me from the dark... I feel like I'm losing my mind. Just give me one pill, I just want to sleep normally...!

li.label: benzodiazepines withdrawal
li.description: My heart is racing and my entire body is shaking uncontrollably. Every little sound feels like a needle stabbing my brain... I'm terrified, I can't breathe. I need that pill to calm me down. Please, just give it to me...!

li.label: sedated by Restoril
li.description: My head is spinning and I can barely steady my feet... but strangely, I feel so at peace. All my worries feel buried deep beneath a fog. I just want to lie down and let go.

li.label: sedated by Ambien
li.description: The drug makes my eyelids heavy and my body feel a bit floaty. But a pleasant, warm comfort is spreading through me, making me feel so relaxed.

li.label: crashing on Benzedrine
li.description: Now that the drug is wearing off, I feel completely drained... My stomach feels sick and everything is just making me irritable.

li.label: high on Benzedrine
li.description: My body feels light and I'm in a pretty good mood. I can keep going for a while without having to sleep or eat.

li.label: crashing on Desoxyn
li.description: My whole body feels like lead and everything is driving me insane. My stomach is turning, my head is splitting... just leave me the hell alone!

li.label: high on Desoxyn
li.description: My mind has never been clearer. I don't feel tired, I don't feel hungry. I feel absolutely invincible!

li.label: crashing on cocaine cola
li.description: The rush is gone, and now everything feels a little flat and irritating.

li.label: high on cocaine cola
li.description: That drink hit like lightning. Everything feels bright, fast, and wonderfully easy.

li.label: drank Cola
li.description: I had a cold, sweet carbonated drink. That bubbly refreshment really cleared my palate and lifted my spirits!

li.label: opioids withdrawal
li.description: It feels like insects are gnawing through the marrow of my bones... My blood is boiling, and this tearing agony won't stop. Please, just give me a single pill... or just kill me already...!

li.label: ketamine withdrawal
li.description: I can't feel where my hands and feet are... The world looks completely twisted, and it feels like my soul has been ripped from my body, drifting like a ghost. I'm terrified. I need that cold numbness to anchor me back to reality...

li.label: high on morphine
li.description: The horrific pain has faded away, feeling like a distant echo. My body is sluggish and foggy, but my mind feels completely at peace.

li.label: soothed by laudanum
li.description: The bitter draught has wrapped everything in a warm, hazy calm. The pain feels distant, and my nerves have finally gone quiet.

li.label: high on fentanyl
li.description: I can't feel any pain at all. My head is a bit foggy, but my entire body feels like it's floating on a warm cloud. I feel so incredibly happy and at peace.

li.label: high on ketamine
li.description: It feels like my body doesn't belong to me, like I'm watching myself from a distance. But all the pain and anxiety feel like someone else's problem far away, which is strangely comforting.

li.label: MKultra conditioning
li.description: I am helping these people of my own free will. This is my duty, and this is where I belong. But... whenever I hear those strange numbers and static noise echoing in the back of my mind, my skin crawls and I feel like losing my sanity. Is the 'me' I remember actually real?
